title: HomeFlood Overdue Installment Fee Give-Back at Final Settlement
content:
**Rule.** The closing payment on a cancelled HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy gives back the overdue installment's installment fee (6 USD on every tier) on the following terms.

| Overdue installment and the request on file | Fee given back |
|---|---|
| fell due after the request's effective date, whatever the reason | in full, 6.00 |
| reason property sold with a settlement statement; fell due on or before the request's effective date and no more than 30 days before it | in full, 6.00 |
| reason replaced coverage with the replacing declarations; fell due on or before the request's effective date and no more than 30 days before it | half, 3.00 |
| otherwise, including when no installment is overdue | nothing |

The give-back is taken off the closing payment. This overrides, for the closing payment only, the term that installment fees are fully earned; the cancellation credit itself keeps installment fees earned.

**The overdue installment.** The overdue installment is the installment of the latest installment fee booked on the term, when no payment with that installment number was received for the term; when that latest installment was paid, no installment is overdue. An installment's due date is the posted date of its installment fee, which is booked on the day the installment falls due under the plan. Where several installment fees share the latest posted date, the one recorded first counts.

**The request on file.** The request on file is the policy's signed cancellation request — the latest received when more than one is signed, and the one recorded first among requests received on the same date; a withdrawn or unsigned request never counts — read for its reason, its effective date and its supporting document.

## Hypothetical cases (request effective 20 May)

| Reason and document | Overdue installment fell due | Give-back |
|---|---|---|
| insured request | 2 June | 6.00 (after the effective date) |
| property sold, settlement statement | 20 April (30 days before) | 6.00 |
| property sold, settlement statement | 19 April (31 days before) | nothing |
| replaced coverage, replacing declarations | 1 May | 3.00 |
| no longer required | 1 May | nothing |
